I am not interested in the world of drawing and AI, I simply use the resources at my disposal. Editing content made by AI is like correcting a coworker's horrible work, it's not very satisfying. [color=#ffff00][u]For those interested in how I edited these portraits, I will leave in the images tab all the images used and the before and after editing of the base image[/u][/color]. [/size]
